about: Mitutoyo 513-404-10E lever dial test indicator on a magnetic stand: four links, eleven CAD materials. Black base, clamps and knob; chrome rods; satin-chrome indicator body; the CAD's yellow dial under its crystal; the base's label and ground pole pieces.
